data.narrative:
Antares is a Series C nuclear energy company founded by Jordan Bramble and Julia DeWahl that has raised $470M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies, with notable private competitors including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation framework here. Using total capital raised ($470M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a typical Series C to later-stage multiplier of 1.7x yields an implied valuation of $799M. This method assumes Antares' funding profile reflects its development trajectory and investor confidence relative to forward dilution.

Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient comparable datapoints; while six nuclear energy peers exist in the broader universe, none meet narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparability. Applying an all-sector median would risk introducing noise unrelated to nuclear-specific fundamentals.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $679M (low) to $919M (high), with a median point of $799M. This narrow single-method basis reflects the constrained peer set and early-stage nature of the sector. Key uncertainties include regulatory pathway clarity, capital efficiency relative to competitors, and technology milestone achievement—factors not directly captured in fundraising multiples alone.
